lines.text: Every night fucks every day up / Every day patches the night up / On God, she gonna leave my ass / She been with the rich nigga, you ain't getting her
Night sweat, everyday in August / Night's light tight when the dark set in / 2 AM howlin' at the moon, holler "If you love me, come and get me, fuck it"
Pushed the Q, sixty-five miles per hour / Dealer in the stu, that's that new shit / Skip straight to the waterfall, that's my first time / Had me looking like I got caught stealing
Go to this side, bullshit in this side, ain't no switching sides / Double back right now / Ace on the 47 on shift / Future sound like you rapping through it / Double park that shit outside

（Beat switch 后）Remember when a nigga had the scale with him / Weighin' up the bags, yeah, had to get it in / I ain't on no rubbin' jig movin' / Later on they had me all up on court talkin' to a judge / Like defend everything, I did it for my niggas, dawg
Won't you chill if I give you a back rub? / I hate when our nights get late / Serotonin rush leave me in a fuckin' dream state / Quick kiss, bitter grin, berry juice on the chin
Nights at the chateau, trapped in my chateau / All on my own / Let my nights last long / I'm stubborn, I want you to let me stay away from we / Goodnight, my love
